name: almond-monorepo
description: Almond Coffee House monorepo — mobile app (almond-app), website (almond-web), and the shared single-source-of-truth package (packages/shared).

scripts.test: npm test --workspace @almond/bff && npm test --workspace almond-app && npm test --workspace almond-web
scripts.typecheck: npm run shared:typecheck && npm run web:typecheck && npm run typecheck --workspace @almond/bff && npm run typecheck --workspace almond-app && tsc -p e2e/tsconfig.json && tsc -p scripts/load/tsconfig.json && tsc -p scripts/pos/tsconfig.json
scripts.coverage: npm run coverage --workspace @almond/bff && npm run coverage --workspace almond-app && npm run coverage --workspace almond-web
